question: Two people drive towards each other from two places which are 56 km apart. The speed of the first person is 12 km/h and speed of the other is 13 km/h. After how long will they be 6 km apart if they start driving together?
solution:
**Given:**

Speed of the first person = 12 km/h

Speed of the second person = 13 km/h

Initial distance between them = 56 km

**Formula Used:**

Relative speed when moving towards each other = Speed of first person + Speed of second person

Time = Distance / Relative Speed

**Calculation:**

Distance to be covered to be 6 km apart = Initial distance - 6

Distance to be covered = 56 - 6 = 50 km

Relative speed = 12 km/h + 13 km/h = 25 km/h

Time taken to be 6 km apart = Distance to be covered / Relative speed

⇒ Time taken = 50 km / 25 km/h

⇒ Time taken = 2 hours

**The correct answer is option 1.**
